answer_1.quote: Neural Machine Translation. Current NMT models employ encoder-decoder architectures.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate translation outputs with BLEU and COMET.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 20 freelance English-French translators on Upwork.
answer_4.guideline: Translators are first asked to select the correct translation out of the two contrastive translations, and then highlight word(s) they found useful to arrive at their answer. Translators also reported their confidence in their answers, choosing from 'not at all', 'somewhat', and 'very'.
